## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-ON. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: VXX (1W: -8.89% | 1M: -18.41%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND (fear easing) and Tech/Small-cap leadership with QQQ (1W: +3.90% | 1M: +3.36%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +3.95% | 1M: +3.83%) ABOVE TREND.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear falling: VXX (1W: -8.89% | 1M: -18.41%) ↓ falling, BELOW TREND. Credit and IG flows constructive: HYG (1W: +0.64% | 1M: +0.55%) ABOVE TREND and LQD (1W: +0.86% | 1M: +0.79%) ABOVE TREND supporting risk appetite.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral-to-supportive: Yield curve (1W: +0.50% | 1M: +2.67%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: +1.30% | 1M: +1.34%) ABOVE TREND show bond demand, while U.S. dollar is NEUTRAL.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech leading: XLK (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.50%) ABOVE TREND; Semis strong: SOXX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%) ABOVE TREND. Financials/cyclicals also strong: XLF proxy (1W: +3.29% | 1M: +5.82%) ABOVE TREND; Energy lagging: XLE (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND. Style: Growth/momentum leadership confirmed.

**5. US vs Global?**
US leadership with breadth-led internals; SPY (1W: +0.57% | 1M: -0.08%) RECOVERY while EM outperforms on a relative basis: EEM (1W: +5.09% | 1M: +1.00%) ABOVE TREND and FXI (1W: +1.55% | 1M: -7.76%) RECOVERY shows selective EM strength.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation present but mixed: ARKK (1W: +4.94% | 1M: +2.09%) ABOVE TREND and IWM (1W: +3.95% | 1M: +3.83%) ABOVE TREND show risk-on flows; IBIT (1W: +5.57% | 1M: -20.12%) RECOVERY flagged as recovery-mode after steep monthly drawdown.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Base/industrial metals recovering: CPER (1W: +3.86% | 1M: -1.79%) RECOVERY. Precious metals under pressure: GLD (1W: -2.45% | 1M: -10.21%) BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -22.76%) BELOW TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy showing weakness: XLE (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND and Brent BNO (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -14.38%) BELOW TREND; Natural gas in short-term pullback: UNG (1W: -2.74% | 1M: +3.37%) CORRECTION.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Tech and semiconductors (XLK, SOXX) and small caps (IWM) ABOVE TREND; VXX falling provides independent risk confirmation. DIVERGENCES: IBIT (1W positive | 1M deeply negative) and SKYY (1W negative | 1M positive) are RECOVERY/CORRECTION signals—minor divergences only.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor Growth/momentum exposures (XLK, SOXX, QQQ) and cyclicals/financials (XLF proxy) showing strength; reduce exposure to Energy (XLE/BNO) and precious metals (GLD/SLV) until trends confirm.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +2.50% | 1M: +4.50%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +10.46% | 1M: +12.86%) ABOVE TREND, IWM (1W: +3.95% | 1M: +3.83%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: XLE (1W: -0.21% | 1M: -0.14%) BELOW TREND, BNO (1W: -6.60% | 1M: -14.38%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: CPER (1W: +3.86% | 1M: -1.79%) RECOVERY if industrial demand continues.  
BEARISH: GLD (1W: -2.45% | 1M: -10.21%) BELOW TREND and SLV (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -22.76%) BELOW TREND on metal outflows.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency marker), HYG/LQD spread ~ watch for stability (credit health), XLK/XLF ratio pivot (tech vs financials balance), SPY 1M breakpoints given RECOVERY status.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-ON. Breadth: 10/11 sectors positive confirming broad strength and VXX (1W: -8.89% | 1M: -18.41%) ↓ falling as a second confirmation. Tech and semiconductors (XLK, SOXX) showing relative strength while Energy (XLE/BNO) and precious metals (GLD/SLV) show weakness to monitor as key divergences.
